card.name: The word wearing or wearer
card.fires_on: The word "wearing" or "wearer" (clothing, gloves, patches, or devices worn on the body). It often follows "while", "by" or "and".

modes.label: Wearing after a linking word
modes.description: The verb "wearing" follows "while", "by", "simply" or "rarely" and describes gloves, clothing or a patch being worn.
modes.example: preferably employing a vertical laminar flow safety hood while<< wearing>> gloves and protective clothing.

modes.label: Wearer as a noun
modes.description: The noun "wearer" names the person who has a garment or device on.
modes.example: Garments that can measure a<< wearer>>'s body temperature or trace their heart activity
